verdict.rationale: Claude Design's entire premise is a built-in AI assistant (Claude) that users delegate design tasks to — generating prototypes, applying design systems automatically, syncing with Claude Code, building from imported components — all confirmed by first-party docs and corroborated by hands-on community reports of successful delegation (landing pages built in hours, solid Claude Code handoff, PenPot flows). Community also reports occasional underwhelming or messy output, but this reflects quality variance rather than the assistant's built-in/delegable nature. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of delegation reliability across varied tasks, and mixed community sentiment on output quality/messy code keeps it below top marks.
